source.title: Dust to Dust
source.description:
Ah yes, the dangers of the desert. No, not the sweltering heat, not the unbearable sunlight, not the sand crawling up into your robes, not the freezing nights.

The other dangers! The bugs, and now the bothersome brutes. Our reconnaissance has reported the Horde are gathering dirt!

I usually wouldn't call this out of the ordinary for them, but Silithyst? I would rather they not uncover the secrets of the sand. As Chief Expeditionary Requisitioner I am requesting a competing order! Get me that dirt!
source.objective: Find and deliver 5 Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with Chief Expeditionary Requisitioner Enkles at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
source.progress:
What are you still doing here <name>? My precognition potion told me you were the person for the job!

We've been able to distill the essence of the Silithus crystals into a potion that grants the user the ability to have limited precognition.

Ah, my apologies, but I have not been authorized to make these potions available to you at this moment.
source.completion:
Very good <name>! Allow me to simply input this transaction into my logbook...

And here you are. If we have any other matters of requisition, I will direct them to you, and as Chief Expeditionary Requisitioner, I do expect assistance.

I unfortunately am not authorized to pay you, but I didn't get to where I am now by not rewarding my underlings! I have in my possession many recipes that were requested but never distributed. As reward, I will allow you to purchase from my library of abandoned knowledge.
